scientific.integrity: The minimum restrained domination number for chain graphs and the complete-bipartite polynomial specialization are treated as prior results. The accepted claim is the all-set boundary characterization and its resulting full polynomial for arbitrary connected chain graphs.
scientific.limitations: Connected chain graphs only. The 2019 restrained-domination-polynomial paper was available only through abstract metadata, and a 2020 study was located only through abstract/search metadata; these are retained as bibliographic risks. The finite verifier covers canonical class-size profiles only through order \(11\) and is supplementary to the proof.

title: All restrained dominating sets and the restrained domination polynomial of chain graphs
